parse.title: Monkey Madness I/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===Well I'll be a monkey's uncle===
{{Checklist|
*Follow the pink path back to the jail, then the cyan path to the [[Monkey child]]'s house.
**Keep an eye on [[The Monkey's Aunt]], it's only safe to be in the garden while she isn't near it.
*Equip your [[M'speak amulet]] and talk to the monkey child.
*Talk to the monkey child twice more. {{Chat option|4Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!|2How many bananas did Aunty want?}}
*Pick 5 [[Banana]]s from the trees in the garden.
*Talk to the monkey child to give him the bananas.
*Leave the garden and wait for the aunt to pass through.
*Talk to the monkey child to get a [[Monkey talisman]].
*''Optional'': If you plan on doing the [[Freeing King Awowogei]] section of [[Recipe for Disaster]]:
**Talk to the monkey child again. {{Chat option|2I've lost that toy you gave me...}}
**Leave the garden, hop worlds or wait for the monkey child to stop crying.
**Talk to the monkey child again. {{Chat option|2Wow - can I borrow it?|1Ok, I promise!}}
**Repeat the above steps until you have four [[Monkey talisman]] in total.
**If doing Freeing King Awowogei section, climb the ladder in the east building from Child, cross bridge east and there will be [[Monkey Archer]]s you can kill and pick up one set of [[Small ninja monkey bones|ninja monkey bones]]}}
